**Finding: compliant** (rule LICENSE, §§ 13.1–13.3)

The licence grant sits at the **preferred** position:

- **Affiliates and contractors** — § 13.1 grants the subscription right directly to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on their behalf," with no written-notice precondition (better than the fallback); § 13.2 extends the paid-up licence to Affiliates and permits contractors to support the material.
- **Not revocable at will** — § 13.2 is "perpetual, irrevocable... fully paid," and § 13.3 bars Vendor from revoking or suspending any licence except for a material uncured payment or use breach, after notice and a reasonable cure opportunity.
- **Transferability** — § 13.3 allows transfer to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by § 24, and § 24.1 permits assignment to an M&A successor without Vendor consent.

No redline proposed. One observation carried forward rather than flagged: § 14.2's "revocable, non-transferable" Deliverable licence conflicts in tone with §§ 13.2, 13.3 and 14.3 — that is a Deliverable-ownership point and belongs to the IP rule, so it is not double-flagged here.
